note: Phase 1 of the monorepo moved three projects in without changing them. Each image here is built from its project's last commit before the move and from the merge that brought the project in, and the two must match apart from what each image allows, with the reason in its note. The after side is the importing merge rather than main-v3, because later pull requests changed each folder on purpose. The build contexts are the ones each project's compose file or script uses.

images.name: web2-admin-backend
images.note: The admin at main-v2, its last commit at the root of this repository, against #19, which moved it into apps/web2-admin with its own workspace. pnpm deploy packs the whole backend folder into /app, so the nine files #19 edited for the new paths are allowed by name, each the same in the image as in its commit: .env.sample, Dockerfile, Dockerfile.dockerignore, README.md, docker-compose.yml and four files of test/integration. The move also took the common package from web2-admin/common to common in the workspace, and pnpm writes that path into its lock record, into the name of the package's folder and into three links. The folder is compared entry by entry under its new name through map, and the lock record and the links are allowed by name. The backend's own link points into the build stage's /repo, so it dangles in both images.

images.name: web2-admin-frontend
images.note: As web2-admin-backend. The image is nginx serving the built bundle. Its one allowed file is nginx.conf, copied in as default.conf, whose comment #19 edited for the new paths.

images.name: hls-stream-uploader
images.note: swarm-hls-stream at fe655bc4 against #15, which added it as apps/hls-stream with its commit ids kept. #21 and #22 changed the folder later. The image copies packages/stream-uploader/dist/, which is built and never committed, so each side first installs from its lockfile and builds the uploader, as deploy/scripts/deploy.sh does before it builds this image. corepack runs the pnpm the stack pins.

images.name: hls-stream-client
images.note: As hls-stream-uploader. Built with the compose file's default build arguments, so both sides carry the same empty build stamp.

images.name: hls-stream-bench
images.note: As hls-stream-uploader. bench-on-host.sh builds it with e2e/ as its context.

images.name: hls-stream-browser
images.note: As hls-stream-bench. browser-on-host.sh builds it through bench-on-host.sh, with the same context.

images.name: infra-manager-api
images.note: streaming-infra-manager at 016c78b5, its last commit, against #20, which pulled it into apps/infra-manager. #24 and #28 changed the folder later.

images.name: infra-manager-frontend
images.note: As infra-manager-api. The image is nginx serving the built console, so nothing is allowed.
